Topic 1.4: Multiplication
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Multiplication, part of Numbers 1.3 Subtraction (6 Lessons) By the end of the sub strand, the learner sh in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade five MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How is Multiplication used in real life? 2. How can you form patterns involving multiplication?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Work out in purposive groups/pairs multiplication of up to a 3 - digit number by up to a 2 - digit number using different methods. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body or appropriate assistive technology to work out 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Work out in purposive groups/pairs multiplication of up to a 3 - digit number by up to a 2 - digit number using different methods. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body or appropriate assistive technology to work out 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Multiplication together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
Unity: as the learner show unity as they team up with peers to create patterns involving multiplication of numbers with products

not exceeding 100.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Self-awareness: as the learner enhances self-esteem as they discover own strategies in multiplication and estimation of products

of numbers.

Link to other subjects

The learner is able to relate the concept of multiplication to sowing tiny seeds gardening skills in Agriculture and Skills.
